usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discover which update-related sub-resources or actions are available under the /remotes/updates namespace. It is a directory index that requires no parameters and is accessible by all authenticated users. Because it returns null, it is most useful for capability probing rather than retrieving actual update data.

examples.summary: List available update sub-resources under remotes

tips: Returns null — treat this as a capability or namespace probe, not a data fetch.
No privilege escalation needed; any valid API token or session can call this.
Pair with specific update-action endpoints discovered via this index to perform actual remote update operations.
